Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
staffan....@mailbox.swipnet.se (staffan.bengtsson) writes:

>Here is some question's about Sabbat:

>1. Why are Gangrel Antitribu so worthless?

Heh. I have no response.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>2. Can I use demonstration to cancel a political action

No. Only cancel votes, not actions.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>3. Pentex love's you TM cost's to much...

Seems OK to me.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>4. I can use Undead Strength with an gas powered chainsaw since i add the
>damage to a melee weapon? Right?

Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>5. Coctoction of Vitality: Can the action use a discipline.

Sure.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>6. Camarilla Threat: Do the "discard" only mean's the discard phase, or can i
>attack someone with raptor's to make them burn pool?

It says "during his or her discard phase", so would apply only to his or
her discards at that time.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>7. "Camarilla vampires cannot vote during this political action" Is this only
>refers to title's, or can I use political card's with only camarilla vampire's
>actiove?

Only titles and Action Modifiers, Reactions, and other vampire-specific
effects are prohibited.
You may still burn PAs

>Can i use Ventrue Hq?

Yes.

>Is Caitiff Camarilla?

Yes.

>Is Caitiff Non camarilla?

No.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>8. May I Freak Drive in torpor? May I Use other Action modifier's in torpor?
>(Stealth for example)?

Yes. Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>9. Who go first: CAilean (nosferatu antitribu) or Shadow Step ?

Whoever is the acting minion.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>10. Why should I use Adaptability?

You don't feel like going to torpor. (It converts the damage from the opposing
minion's strike.)

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>11. What do Infernal Familiar better than a discipline card?

Bestows more than one discipline (namely, "all" of them).

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>12. If i commit diableri on a vampire, and he is recovering with Reform Body,
>is it still Diableri?

Yes. (No ruling has been given to overturn that, so go by the rules).

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>13. If I prevent the damage from BoneCraft or FleshCraft - do I take the flaw's
>anyway?

Yes.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>14. Can any vampire become "Sabbat" somehow?

Not with the current card set (I believe).

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>15. Can I become "Serpent's Of The Light", Sabbat Setites with Clan
>Impersonation? and become sabbat? =) ?

No. You can only impersonate a clan that exists in the card game.

>------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>16. May I Use Cardinal Sin: Insubordination If im in torpor?

Reaction cards should not be usable from torpor, but I cnnot find a rule
or other reference for that, so "Yes."
